title: Basis of the Acre Charge on a Completed Pass under Custom Application and Field Services
content:
Each operation under Custom Application and Field Services carries its own rate per acre, and the plan decides whether that rate is held for the crop year or taken from the posted sheet on the day the pass was run.

**Which rate governs.** Where the plan holds rates, the rate is the one in force when the plan was accepted and it does not move however the posted sheet moves. Where the plan does not hold rates, the rate is the posted rate on the work date rather than on the date the order was written.

**The charge.** The charge for a completed pass is the rate for the operation multiplied by the acres billed, and the acres billed are never fewer than the programme's minimum billable acres. Put as a definition of the quantity: the acres billed are the greater of the acres covered on the pass and the programme's minimum billable acres; the charge is that acreage multiplied by the rate for the operation run; and the charge is rounded to two decimal places, that is, to the nearest cent.

**One pass, one rate.** An operation the plan does not carry a rate for is not worked under that plan at all, and the member is written a per-acre order instead. Where two operations are run over the same ground on the same day each is billed at its own rate, because each is a separate pass.

**What is not in the acre charge.** Product applied is billed separately through the member's crop input account and never rolled into the acre charge.

## Two worked figures on hypothetical inputs

Take a hypothetical rate of 11.23 USD per acre for the operation run, on a plan whose programme sets the minimum billable acres at 10.

*Pass covering 12.6 acres.* The acres covered exceed the minimum billable acreage, so the acres billed are 12.6. Multiplied by the rate the charge comes to 141.498, which rounded to the nearest cent is 141.50 USD.

*Pass covering 6.4 acres.* The acres covered are fewer than the minimum billable acreage, so the acres billed are 10. Multiplied by the rate the charge is 112.30 USD. The member is billed on 10 acres although 6.4 were covered.

*The same two operations on one day.* Had a second operation been run over the same 12.6 acres on the same day, it would be billed at its own rate for that operation over the same acreage, as a separate pass, rather than being folded into the first charge.
